scholarships.description: For undergraduates with exceptional financial need. Limited funding.

scholarships.name: Career-Targeted Awards
scholarships.description: Scholarships supporting STEM transitions, women in tech, and first responders.

scholarships.name: Scholarship Disbursement
scholarships.description: The $3,000 scholarship will be disbursed after the completion of the first session in four equal installments of $750.00 each. All installments will be disbursed once final grades are posted by the faculty. The student will receive credit towards their ledger card.

scholarships.name: Scholarship Overview
scholarships.description: The Career Elevation $1,000.00 Scholarship provides a maximum award of $1,000, disbursed after the completion of the student’s second and third academic sessions, contingent upon meeting the GPA requirements outlined below.

scholarships.name: Application of Award
scholarships.description: Scholarship funds will be posted directly to the student’s ledger only after final grades are officially recorded for each applicable session. American Dream Scholarship

scholarships.name: Tuition Discount Eligibility
scholarships.description: Eligible students are active-duty U.S. military members or eligible spouses from all branches who provide valid proof of eligibility or eligible to utilize MyCAA.

scholarships.name: Tuition Discounting Limitation
scholarships.description: Department of Defense Tuition Assistance (TA) and MyCAA will be applied as the primary source of payment toward tuition.
